sections.heading: Description
lines: Underwater is one of the Field Effects present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as an Elemental field and can be found in any diving area.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: Water Surface will transform into this field if the moves Anchor Shot, Dive, Grav Apple, Gravity or Triple Dive are used.
“The battle was pulled underwater!”
“The battle sank into the depths!”

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Electric-type moves → 2x boost, never miss.
“The water super-conducted the attack!”
Water-type moves → 1.5x boost, deals neutral damage against the Water-type.
“The water strengthened the attack!”
Fire-type moves always fail.
“...But the attack was doused instantly!”
Ground-type moves gain a Water sub-type.
Physical moves → 0.5x decrease.
Does not apply to Water-type moves or moves used by Water-type Pokémon
Non-Water-type Pokémon have their Speed halved.
Pokémon with the abilities Eelevate, Surge Surfer or Swift Swim are immune to this effect.
All weather and Terrains are terminated, and cannot be generated.
“You're too deep to notice the weather!”
“The terrain disappeared in the water!”
Field damage:
Pokémon weak to the Water type take type-scaling damage each turn (1/4 max HP if 2x weak, 1/2 max HP if 4x weak).
“[Pokémon] struggled in the water!”
Pokémon take no damage if they have the abilities Dry Skin, Magic Guard, Storm Drain or Swift Swim.
Pokémon take 2x damage if they have the abilities Flame Body or Magma Armor.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Activated Abilities:
Hydration
Schooling
Applies even when the user is level 19 or less.
Swift Swim
Torrent
Buffed Abilities:
Dry Skin & Water Absorb restore 1/16 of the bearer's max HP at the end of each turn
“[Pokémon] absorbed some of the water!”
Propeller Tail boosts the damage of the bearer's priority moves by 1.5x.
This does not apply to moves that gain priority (Example: Grassy Glide, Gale Wings).
Steam Engine raises the bearer's Speed by 1 stage at the end of each turn.
Water Compaction activates at the end of each turn.
Water Veil prevents the bearer from being affected with non-volatile status condition.
A Pokémon with this Ability will be cured of status at the end of the turn.
Other Ability Changes:
Gulp Missile will always pick up Arrokuda, which deals type-scaling Water damage.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Dragon Darts → 2x boost, Water sub-type.
“From the depths!”
Anchor Shot → 2x boost.
“From the depths!”
Jet Punch, Water Pulse → 1.5x boost.
“Jet-streamed!”
Other moves:
Aqua Ring restores 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn.
Dive lasts only 1 turn.
Grav Apple gain a Water sub-type.
Octolock lowers Defense and Speciald Defense by 2 stages each.
Spicy Extract & Tar Shot fails on use.
“The extract washed away!”
“The tar washed off instantly!”
As of V14.0.22, the in-game Field Notes do not mention that Tar Shot also gets removed at the end of the turn.
Take Heart raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 2 stages.
Wave Crash's recoil is reduced to 25%.
Whirlpool deals 1/6 max HP damage and confuses the target.
Field-dependent moves:
Camouflage changes the user's type to Water.
Nature Power becomes Water Pulse.
Secret Power may lower Attack by 1 stage.
Shelter halves damage from Water-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Water.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost on top of any other previously listed modifiers.
This field will transform into Water Surface if the moves Bounce, Dive, Fly, Shore up, Sky Drop or Triple Dive are used.
“The battle resurfaced!”

This field will transform into Murkwater Surface if the move Sludge Wave is used 2 times or the Z-Move Acid Downpour is used 1 time, causing all non-Poison-type and non-Steel-type Pokémon on the field to faint.
“The grime sank beneath the battlers!”

sections.heading: Items
lines: Elemental Seed raises the user's Speed by 1 stage and changes their type to Water.
“[Pokémon] transformed into the Water type!”
The Dive Ball's catch rate buff is enabled.
The Dusk Ball's catch rate buff is enabled.

sections.heading: Notes
lines: Neved's Jurisdiction fails on this field.
“The cannonfire missed the underwater battlers entirely!”
